summary: Top opportunity today is a qualifying Lane C story. On 22 Oct 2026, HCPLive reported results from TRANSCEND-CKD, a Phase 2b retatrutide kidney trial presented at ASN Kidney Week (21–25 Oct). It enrolled 146 adults with overweight or obesity and chronic kidney disease. Among those with raised urine albumin at the start, albumin fell 53.7% at 24 weeks on retatrutide versus 8.8% on placebo, and measured kidney filtration did not change. It names retatrutide (our best-performing drug name), it's less than 48 hours old, and creator coverage is still thin. Per the playbook, publish the long-form first, then a 20:00 funnel Short. Second: CBS News's 21 Oct lab test of products sold as 'retatrutide' gives the gray-market 'what's confirmed?' lane a fresh, dated fact. One sample had no peptide in it and had bacterial growth. Never name sellers. Also strong for Lane A: Medicare's $50-a-month GLP-1 Bridge (who qualifies, WCPO 22 Oct), 'Could retatrutide break a plateau?' (Medscape 20 Oct), 'GLP-1 supplements' (Fortune 22 Oct), and the Wegovy pill (Annals uptake study). Menopause plus GLP-1 (the CagriSema post hoc and the Mayo hormone-therapy cohort) keeps getting fresh coverage and works for body-effect Shorts. Korea's efpeglenatide (Eppe) launches 29 Oct, which gives us a scheduled Lane C slot. The addiction and mental-health topics are emerging but need careful wording. We still reject the retatrutide 'sourcing checklist' content. Verification: the TRANSCEND-CKD, CBS, Medicare Bridge, Eppe, Medscape and Annals details were checked. The Psychol Med depression RCT couldn't be fetched, so its details need the fact-checker.

candidates.topic: Retatrutide and the kidneys: TRANSCEND-CKD Phase 2b (146 adults with overweight/obesity and chronic kidney disease, 24 weeks, ASN Kidney Week Oct 21–25, 2026). Among people with raised urine albumin at the start, albumin fell 53.7% vs 8.8% on placebo; measured kidney filtration unchanged
candidates.angle: Lane C first explainer, published the same day. Title idea: 'Retatrutide and Kidney Disease: First Trial Results Explained' (≤60 characters, no abbreviations). Explain what urine albumin means, why 'kidney filtration unchanged' at 24 weeks is a neutral finding (not proof of protection), and how it compares with semaglutide's approved FLOW kidney result. Make the trial's limits clear: Phase 2b, 146 people, 24 weeks, a lab-marker result rather than a kidney-failure outcome. Retatrutide is not approved anywhere. Mention the main common side effects (stomach and gut symptoms) and the pulse rise. Funnel Short at 20:00 names the long-form. Prescriber line.
candidates.predicted_peak: 2–6 days (through the end of ASN Kidney Week and the follow-up trade press)
candidates.why_now: Presented at ASN Kidney Week 2026 (Oct 21–25). HCPLive covered it Oct 22. Named next-gen drug, new trial result, under 48 h old: it meets the Lane C rule exactly. Retatrutide-named Shorts have a median of 120. No consumer YouTube coverage found yet.

evidence.signal: TRANSCEND-CKD: 146 participants. Among people with UACR ≥30 at baseline, UACR fell 53.7% vs 8.8% on placebo. Measured GFR unchanged. Weight −14.0 kg. Systolic BP −14 mm Hg. Pulse +9 bpm.

candidates.topic: Retatrutide sold online and in stores: what lab testing found (CBS News, Oct 21, 2026). One vial bought in a store had no peptide in it, just a fragrance filler, and University of Iowa testing grew 13 bacterial colonies from a sample. FDA has received 2 death reports; causation not established
candidates.angle: Lane B, 'What's Actually Confirmed?' series. Title idea: 'Retatrutide Online: What Lab Tests Found (Oct 2026)'. Credit each fact to its source with a date: CBS News and University of Iowa scientists (Oct 21), the FDA (2 death reports, causation uncertain), Lilly (not approved, lawsuits). Never name sellers or describe how to buy. Close by pointing viewers to a prescriber about approved options or enrolling in a clinical trial. Calm tone, no scare framing. The Short adds this one new dated fact (counts as this week's single gray-market Short).
candidates.why_now: New CBS lab-test report Oct 21, picked up by Newser and others. It joins the Penn AI Reddit study (ScienceDaily Oct 21) and the Australian emergency-admission reports (Oct 21). Our gray-market lane has a median of 103.5 and retatrutide titles a median of 120.
